chunks: So let there be a body among you who may call to the good, enjoin what is esteemed and forbid what is odious. They are those who will be successful.
ai.seo_question: What are the three main duties of the Muslim community according to Surah Al-Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the foundation of the 'Amr bil-Ma'ruf wa Nahy anil-Munkar' principle, a continuous duty for the entire community rather than limited to the Imams. It underscores that true success (Al-Muflihun) is contingent upon active participation in social reform, linking individual piety with collective moral responsibility.
